An elegant and robust solution in Python to calculate the average rate of change per unit time. 

By definition, the average rate of change of a series over an interval is the change in the dependent variable (value) divided by the change in the independent variable (time) between the starting and ending points. Intermediate points do not affect this overall average.

### Python Solution

```python
def avg_rate(series):
    # Sort the series by time to ensure we correctly identify the start and end points
    sorted_series = sorted(series, key=lambda x: x[0])
    
    # Calculate the total change in value and time
    delta_value = sorted_series[-1][1] - sorted_series[0][1]
    delta_time = sorted_series[-1][0] - sorted_series[0][0]
    
    # Calculate the average rate of change
    rate = delta_value / delta_time
    
    # Return as a string rounded to 2 decimal places
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
```
